discussion.title: No qualifying correction found in the inspected path
discussion.status: Review integrated; empirical scope proposal pending
discussion.summary: The inspected path supplies no evidenced API-use correction, including its move-to-active-Space setting. The bounded finding survives review. Antony still must choose whether to permit empirical ordering design, retain the hold, or end unresolved. Both orders succeeded with synchronous file tracing; reversing calls moved the writes, and there is no instrument-free comparison. Reduced failure risk is not established. The proposed finite bound is an agreed convention: a qualified recurrence rejects the repair, unavailable required evidence prevents acceptance, and every required ordinary assertion must pass. A passing bound supports only that sample. No number, candidate or guest is selected; all six causal slots remain held and cause/ownership unresolved.

diagrams.title: Why the current probe does not discriminate cause
diagrams.caption: Appearance, main-resignation and front/resume observations do not identify a matched intervention. Qualified failures can refute row-click or marker necessity only when absence is independently established; the broad rivals have no finite falsifier.
